acceptanceEvidence: src/domains/site-content/fields-public.ts adds about 175 items covering the menu, notice bar, footer, home (opened and before opening), pricing, contact page and form, how it works, service area, launch page and form, city pages and their search titles; each has page, section and plain label; the legal pages and the contract-term, interest and consent wording are declared exceptions in tests/public-pages-render.test.tsx and the legal bodies stay tied to their approval versions; the marker test proves every item shows up and nothing else is left.

tests/fixtures/public-pages/*.txt hold the visible words, links, picture addresses and alt text of 13 routes captured from the original code; tests/public-pages-render.test.tsx renders every route with starting content and compares to the saved text with no update flag; the only difference is the launch page business-name line, changed on purpose.

tests/public-pages-render.test.tsx replaces every editable text and button with a unique marker, renders all 13 routes plus 8 variants and a real-form interaction test, requires each item to show its marker and each leftover visible line to be a marker, a declared fact (business name, phone, email, address, hours, closures, social, cities, ZIPs, catalog names, prices, fees) or a named exception; this is a runtime render, not a code search.

src/domains/site-content/richtext.ts and fields.ts fill and check inline links and fact names: tests/vc3-public-bindings.test.ts proves unknown pages, http, javascript, credentials, protocol-relative and malformed links and unknown {facts} are refused on save (older text path, typed path and button words) and tests/vc3-public-content-integration.test.ts proves publishing refuses a stored bad value; the late-fee days come from Settings and a test proves starting texts hold no price, phone or email; hours, closures, prices, fees and cities render from Settings in the marker test.

SiteCta resolves each button from a link item (known page, https address, or the profile's phone or email, nothing shown if the profile has none); nav-links.ts keeps header and footer destinations in code with editable required words (test: words change, destinations do not, pricing hidden before opening); fields cannot be emptied (test on menu, footer, login and legal words); the saved link item holds words and destination separately.

HeroPicture shows the website picture with its description, decorative choice and focus point when set and the built-in photo otherwise; tests/vc3-public-content-integration.test.ts proves a draft picture is not servable to the public until publish and is served to the preview, and that only an active owner or admin gets the draft preview while visitors and customers get live content; the marker test covers the default picture and tests keep the original alt text.

promotions.ts judges a banner and a home box per page view from stored UTC times in Colorado terms (default off; scheduled, live, ended); tests/vc3-public-bindings.test.ts covers off, before, start, last second, end and the 2026-11-01 fall-back and 2027-03-14 spring-forward conversions (non-existent time refused, ambiguous time takes the earlier instant); the integration test shows an ended or not-started box disappears while other content stays; values.ts now refuses any priced-offer link.

getSiteForRequest in src/domains/site-content/request.ts is the one reader every public page and form uses (home, pricing, contact, how it works, service area, launch, city pages, layout chrome); unit and real-Postgres tests prove an owner or admin may read a draft, an old version and a future moment while staff, customers and visitors always get live content and the real time.

externalAcceptance: Real use after the daily release: nothing on the public site changes until the owner edits something; the owner screens for editing arrive in V-C4. Uploaded home photos and promotion pictures need the private picture store configured in production (as noted for V-C2).
Browser and accessibility checks of the changed public pages run in exact-head CI.
Website picture bytes are still not in the daily recovery media copy and cleanup is unscheduled (carried from V-C2).
evidence: Local: typecheck, lint and wording checks pass; 13 saved page texts match exactly (launch page business-name line updated deliberately); marker coverage test renders every route and 8 variants (empty price list, empty service area, catalog photos, legal pages approved, no appliance options, before-opening) and fails on any visible word that is neither a marker, a declared owner fact nor a named exception, and on any item that never appears; real form tests for company name, sending, thank-you and launch saving; 20 unit tests for links, facts, promotions across both daylight-saving changes, nav, and preview access; 4 real-Postgres tests; the full run passes apart from the earlier custody Denver-date test and one messaging test that fails only on a database with leftovers and passes on a fresh one; exact-head CI pending.
